serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Oracle Aconex provides the #1 cloud and mobile collaboration platform for the global construction industry. This highly secure platform provides a single source of truth for all program related documents and communications across agency stakeholders and streamlines business process management with standardization across the project lifecycle. Oracle Aconex for Defense brings a modern set of flexible tools for simplifying how program data is captured, consumed, shared and analyzed.

Capabilities include:
- Inter-Agency Project Management and Collaboration
- Centralized Information Management
- Streamlined Business Process and Construction Management
- Secure Common Data Environment With more than 70,000 user organizations and over $1 trillion of project value delivered in more than 70 countries, Aconex is the construction industry’s most widely adopted and trusted platform. For more information, please see Oracle Aconex for Defense (https://www.oracle.com/industries/construction-engineering/aconex-fedramp-construction-software/)
